entry.name: CS285: Deep Reinforcement Learning
entry.note: Sergey Levine's graduate RL course, lectures and homework public

reading.format: In-person lectures on Wednesdays and Fridays, with office hours and a final project.
reading.summary: This is an on-campus course on deep reinforcement learning at UC Berkeley. It includes lectures, office hours, and a final project. The course is not offered online, and recorded videos are for personal use only.
reading.audience: It is intended for EECS graduate students. Undergraduates, fifth-year MS students, and non-EECS graduate students may apply for enrollment through a form.
